source.exploreUrl:
<js>
//状态
novelState = [
	{	title: '全部', type: 0},
	{	title: '连载', type: 1},
	{	title: '完结', type: 2}
]
//分类
novelSort = [
	{	title: '　全部　', type: 0},
	{	title: '玄幻奇幻', type: 1},
	{	title: '仙侠武侠', type: 2},
	{	title: '都市言情', type: 3},
	{	title: '穿越历史', type: 4},
	{	title: '科幻灵异', type: 5},
	{	title: '  藏经阁  ', type: 6},
	{	title: '其他类别', type: 7}
]
//排序
novelRank = [
	{ title: '  更新  ', type: 'lastupdate'},
	{ title: '总人气', type: 'allvisit'},
	{ title: '月人气', type: 'monthvisit'},
	{ title: '  字数  ', type: 'size'},
	{ title: '  新书  ', type: 'postdate'}
]

list = [];
formatUrl = (sort, rank, state) => {
	return `{{eval(String(source.loginUrl));_getUrl();}}shuku/${sort}-${rank}-${state}-{{page}}.html`;
}
pushItem = (title, url, basis) => {
	list.push({
		title: title,
		url: url,
		style: {
			layout_flexGrow: 1,
			layout_flexBasisPercent: basis
		}
	});
}

for (stateItem of novelState) {
	pushItem(`🚫小说状态---${stateItem.title}🚫`, "", 1);
	for (rankItem of novelRank) {
		novelSort[0].title = "📫" + rankItem.title;
		for (sortItem of novelSort) {
			pushItem(`${sortItem.title}`, formatUrl(sortItem.type, rankItem.type, stateItem.type), sortItem.type > 5 ? 0.4 : 0.25);
		}
	}
}
JSON.stringify(list);
</js>

<js>
java.longToast("如果失败可能网址失效了");
(function() {
    try {
        // 第一步：获取HTML
        var baseUrl = "https://ztopaqt4g7g7.hq555.icu:1678";
        var html = java.connect(baseUrl + "/so").getBody();
        if (!html) return '';
        
        // 第二步：解析HTML
        var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
        
        // 第三步：获取标题元素
        var titles = doc.select('.layui-tab-item-title');
        // java.log("找到标题数量: " + titles.size());
        
        if (titles.size() < 3) {
            java.log("标题数量不足3个");
            return '';
        }
        
        // 第四步：定位第二个和第三个标题
        var secondTitle = titles.get(1);
        var thirdTitle = titles.get(2);
        
        // java.log("第二个标题: " + secondTitle.text());
       //  java.log("第三个标题: " + thirdTitle.text());
        
        // 第五步：遍历中间的元素
        var results = [];
        var currentElement = secondTitle.nextElementSibling();
        var elementCount = 0;
        
        while (currentElement && !currentElement.equals(thirdTitle)) {
            elementCount++;
            
            if (currentElement.hasClass('layui-tab-item-tagContainer')) {
                // java.log("找到第" + elementCount + "个tagContainer");
                
                var links = currentElement.select('a');
                java.log("该容器中有" + links.size() + "个链接");
                
                for (var i = 0; i < links.size(); i++) {
                    var link = links.get(i);
                    
                    // 提取名称
                    var span = link.selectFirst('span.layui-tab-item-tagContainer-tag');
                    var name = '';
                    if (span) {
                        name = span.text().trim();
                    } else {
                        name = link.text().trim();
                    }
                    
                    // 提取链接
                    var href = link.attr('href');
                    
                    if (name && href) {
                        // 处理相对链接
                        if (!href.startsWith('http')) {
                            if (href.startsWith('/')) {
                                href = baseUrl + href;
                                href = href +"/{{page}}";
                            } else {
                                href = baseUrl + '/' + href;
                                href = href +"/{{page}}";
                            }
                        }
                        
                        results.push(name + "::" + href);
                        java.log("添加: " + name + " -> " + href);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            currentElement = currentElement.nextElementSibling();
        }
        
        java.log("总共处理了" + elementCount + "个元素");
        java.log("最终结果数量: " + results.length);
        
        return results.join('\n');
        
    } catch (error) {
        java.log("捕获到错误: " + error);
        return '';
    }
})()
</js>

<js> 
var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text()) ;
var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));
var book = {
	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),
	author: og('novel:author'),
	kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/, ''),
	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, ''),
	intro: '　　最近更新:' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-') + '\n' + o('#intro').replace(/.*(观看小说|简介)[:：]|各位书友.*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '\n'),
	cover: og('image'),
	url: og('novel:read_url'),
};
book;
</js>

	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, ''),

	cover: og('image'),
	url: og('novel:read_url').replace('/txt','/readbook'),
};
book;
</js>
